criteria.statement: When streaming returns no content deltas, the planner falls back to the non-streaming completion and parses the plan from the full message content.
A streamed model refusal with empty content surfaces as a clarification AssistantPlan (NeedsClarification=true with the refusal text) and does not trigger the non-streaming fallback.
When the provider streams content deltas normally, the plan is parsed from the accumulated stream, onChunk receives the deltas, and no non-streaming fallback occurs.
When both streaming and non-streaming return empty with no refusal, a clear actionable error is returned instead of a bare empty-response message.
ContextTooLargeError classification is preserved on the streaming path.
